registerIntro: Register, then scan with your phone to pair your computer.
loginIntro: Sign in to access DeepSeek Harness on your paired computers.
passwordLength: Password must have at least 8 characters.
mockLogin: Mock Relay is enabled. Use any valid email and a password with at least 8 characters.
secureCredentials: Credentials are stored only in the system secure storage.
devicesIntro: Select a computer to open remote DeepSeek Harness.
removePairingBody: After removing the pairing with {name}, you will need to scan again at the computer.
missingKey: The encryption key for this computer is not on this phone. Pair it again.
browserFailed: Could not open the browser. Try again later.
noComputersIntro: Run npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web on the computer, then scan the pairing code shown by dsh-mobile.
confirmationPending: The computer has not confirmed pairing yet. Keep waiting; there is no need to scan again.
claimedError: {error} The pairing code is already claimed; there is no need to scan again.
manualUnsupported: To ensure end-to-end encryption, version 0.1.5 only supports scanning the QR code on the computer.
claimedWaiting: Pairing code claimed. Waiting for dsh-mobile to confirm.
notConfirmed: The computer has not confirmed yet.
scanInstruction: Place the pairing QR code from the computer terminal inside the frame.
codeHelp: The code appears in the terminal running npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web and is valid for 5 minutes.
validRelay: Enter a valid Relay address (HTTPS in release builds).
remoteFilesHelp: Browse computer files and preview common formats
offlineHelp: Make sure npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web is running on the computer. dsh-mobile starts and stops with it.
dshOfflineHelp: The computer is online. Run npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web on it.
timeoutHelp: Relay timed out waiting for the computer. Check your network and try again.
rescanHelp: Version 0.1.5 enables end-to-end encryption. Remove the old pairing and scan the new QR code on the computer.
connectionFailedHelp: Could not determine the computer or DSH status. Try again later.
mockSessionHelp: With a real Relay build, the computer’s DSH Web UI loads here.
upToDate: You are using the latest version.
updateCheckFailed: Could not check for updates. Try again later.
unsupportedVersion: This version is no longer supported. Update to continue.
downloadFailed: Could not open the download page.
networkError: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
invalidCode: The pairing code is invalid or expired.
forbidden: You do not have access to this computer.
notFound: The computer does not exist or is no longer paired.
relayMismatch: The QR code belongs to another Relay. Check the computer configuration.
encryptedQrRequired: Scan the encrypted pairing QR code on the computer.
encryptionRequired: Scan this computer again to establish an encryption key.
cameraUnavailable: Camera unavailable. Allow camera access in system settings, then try scanning again.
